entries.zh: 蠔壳灰；牡蛎壳烧成的石灰（用于建筑或浆刷）
entries.en: lime made from oyster shells; oyster-shell lime
entries.notes: L 栏拼写缺损（buyc/quamdo 疑难），但 H『蠔壳灰』与 R『hōn cō hùi』互证为蠔壳烧灰，西语 cal 亦合；L 栏语句残损故降为 medium

entries.zh: 泡饭；以汤水泡饭而食（morisquera 指细碎饭粒的食物）
entries.en: rice soaked/sopped in broth or water; soft-boiled rice pap
entries.notes: H 栏字有疑难（泡/疱、閻/閹），M『pān pay àn』与 R『pōn jān àn』对音支持『泡饭』，西语 caldo de morisquera 指碎米泡汤食物，展开依赖推断故 medium

entries.zh: 豆油；豆豉酱汁，咸味调味汁
entries.en: bean sauce; fermented soybean sauce (salado = salted)
entries.notes: H『荳油』清晰，R『tēn iēn』对音略有出入，M 栏另附 ti-tsiap（豉汁）一形；按 17 世纪马尼拉语境释为豆豉酱汁，confidence=medium

entries.zh: 历；历书
entries.en: calendar; almanac

entries.zh: 历日；全年的历书
entries.en: annual calendar; yearly almanac

entries.zh: 燥；使热，或（中医意义上）热而干的性质
entries.en: to heat/warm; hot and dry (of a thing)

entries.zh: 燥热；热而干燥（的性味或状态）
entries.en: hot and dry; dry heat

entries.zh: 灼；炙烤自身，受热取暖
entries.en: to warm/burn oneself; to scorch

entries.zh: 灼烧；就火取暖
entries.en: to warm oneself by the fire

entries.zh: 灼火；向火取暖
entries.en: to warm oneself at the fire

entries.zh: 热；发热，或如火般灼热之物
entries.en: hot; to be hot like fire

entries.zh: 热火；热如火
entries.en: hot as fire; burning hot

entries.zh: 炒；加热并焙炒（干锅翻炒）
entries.en: to stir-fry; to heat and toast/parch

entries.zh: 炒过；已焙炒（如焙炒辣椒 piambres）
entries.en: toasted/parched (e.g. peppers roasted over fire); to have stir-fried

entries.zh: 炒烧；炒而烧热
entries.en: to stir-fry and heat; parch hot

entries.zh: 烘；以余火煨焙取暖
entries.en: to warm at the embers; to roast over coals
entries.notes: M 栏 tone_marks 含 T99（污損難辨），封存件音标受损；H『烘』与 R『hòng hò』仍清晰互证，释义可靠但按纪律降为 medium

entries.zh: 烘火；就炭火余烬取暖
entries.en: to warm oneself at the embers/fire
entries.notes: M 栏 tone_marks 含 T99（污損難辨）；H『烘火』与 R『hòng hò』互证清楚，释义可靠但按纪律降为 medium

entries.zh: 放水；此处指烧热水（把水放上/兑入，引申为热汤）
entries.en: to put on water; to heat water (set water to boil)
entries.notes: 西语 calentar agua 与 H『放水』/R『fàng zùi』字面为『放水』，17 世纪闽语『放水』于此语境应指烧水，语义衔接依赖推断故 medium

entries.zh: 煎药；熬煮药剂
entries.en: to boil/decoct medicine
entries.notes: H『煎藥』与 R『chīn yò』互证清晰，但 M 栏『fim』首字母（f-）音写异常，展开依赖推断故 medium

entries.zh: 温烧；于炉火旁或被中温热取暖
entries.en: to warm at the fire, or in bed; to keep warm
